ModMetaData.name: RimArts: Combat Abilities
ModMetaData.author: vilasone455
ModMetaData.description:
Fifteen combat ability kits, each with one clear source: gene, trait, implant, equipment, weapon trait, or earned origin.
Spit acid to disarm enemies, burn nutrition to heal, scatter into crows, bend time, reflect attacks, open pocket dimensions, command foes, and rain blades across the battlefield. Every power carries a cost, vulnerability, or tactical commitment.
Five biological kits come from genes. The others belong to distinct traits, implants, equipment, weapons, or Origin: Blade, a permanent path earned through combat and crafting skill.
The cryo bandolier throws a frost bomb by hand, with a full throwing animation when Melee Animation is installed.
No psycasts and no separate magic system.
Requires Biotech and Harmony. Optional support for Odyssey, Combat Extended, Melee Animation and Unique Melee Weapons.
